Level 1 - Kid 35 min LLD OOP Memory

Classes, Objects & Memory: Stack vs Heap

After this page you can say exactly what a class is and what an object is, draw where each piece of a running program lives (stack, heap, static), explain why Java "passes references by value", and avoid the three bugs that sink LLD code: comparing with ==, overriding equals without hashCode, and forgetting that a reference can be null.
